A loan of Rs. 8,000 is to be repaid in 2 equal annual installments at 5% p.a. CI. Find each installment.

In a high-stakes corporate restructuring, the Chairman delivered a speech that was widely regarded as a __________ for morale, as his sudden resignation announcement turned hopeful anticipation into deep despair.
questions.solution: A blessing or boon implies improvement; a nuisance is minor. The context describes a negative outcome (despair) from an expected positive event, making 'curse' the only logical synonym for a misfortune.

options.label: B
options.text: More than 50% of India's population will live in water-stressed regions

options.text: All of India will be water-stressed

questions.text: The correct form of the sentence 'By the time I will finish my homework, it will be midnight' is?

options.label: A
options.text: By the time I finish my homework, it will be midnight

options.label: B
options.text: By the time I will have finished my homework, it will be midnight

options.label: C
options.text: By the time I have finished my homework, it will be midnight

options.label: D
options.text: By the time I am finishing my homework, it will be midnight

questions.solution: The correct form of the sentence is in the simple future tense, as it describes an action that will be completed at a specific point in the future.

questions.text: Passage: 'The Right to Information (RTI) Act, passed in 2005, empowered Indian citizens to demand information from public authorities. It was hailed as a landmark legislation for transparency. However, recent amendments have raised concerns about the weakening of the RTI Act, with critics arguing that the changes undermine the very purpose of the law.' What is the main idea of the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: The RTI Act was passed in 2005

options.label: B
options.text: The RTI Act, once a landmark for transparency, now faces concerns due to amendments that may weaken its purpose

options.label: C
options.text: Citizens can demand information from public authorities

options.label: D
options.text: All amendments to laws are harmful

questions.solution: Correct answer: The RTI Act, once a landmark for transparency, now faces concerns due to amendments that may weaken its purpose.

questions.solution: Information Given: Series: PQR, STU, VWX; find next cluster. R eference: uploaded question set. Logic: Each letter in a position advances by +3 in the alphabet (wrap after Z).
